policy.vintage: Latest retrieved vintage; revisions are not point-in-time reconstructed. Not an ALFRED vintage backtest.
policy.alignment: Backward as-of at each exchange local close; no backfill, interpolation, or future values

vix.units: VIX index points (30-day implied volatility, annualized %)

usdcad.units: CAD per 1 USD; positive return = USD appreciation

usdtwd.units: TWD per 1 USD; positive return = USD appreciation

policy.bull: close >= own-market SMA200 at forecast origin
policy.bear: close < own-market SMA200 at forecast origin
policy.high_volatility: 20-session realized volatility >= prior 756-session 75th percentile (minimum 252 observations; threshold shifted one session)
policy.regime_overlap: Bull/bear partition the sample; high/normal volatility are a separate, overlapping partition

eras.recent: origin on/after 2024-01-01; already inspected in prior research, not an untouched holdout

policy.stability_rule: Overall relative MAE gain >=1%, positive unadjusted 95% lower bound, Holm-adjusted one-sided p<0.05, positive gains in bull/bear/high/normal volatility and both eras with >=20 forecasts each, >=5 complete origin-years and gains in >=2/3 of those years
policy.inference: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap, 5 chronological forecasts per block, 4000 repetitions, seed=42. Resample regime masks jointly on the original timeline; do not concatenate disjoint regime episodes.
policy.multiplicity: Holm across 42 overall tests (7 combinations x 3 primary markets x 2 horizons). Nasdaq is a separate 14-test exploratory family; slice intervals are unadjusted diagnostics.
policy.selection: Research screening only; no automatic model switch and no genuinely untouched holdout
